# T-2: Make report delivery explicit

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Represent linked-Issue delivery as delivered or unsent/pending, and block report completion until required delivery succeeds.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R2 linked-Issue delivery failure prevents done while no-linked-Issue reports retain success.
- R3 delivery failure records explicit unsent or pending state.
- R4 each retry command invocation makes at most one attempt for only missing delivery with the existing idempotency key.

## Implementation Notes
Retain FlowOutbox and commentOnIssueOnce as the delivery/retry owner. Remove the gh-unavailable skipped-success outcome rather than translating it to done.

## Test Strategy
Extend finalization/report tests for gh unavailable, comment failure, successful delivery, no-linked-Issue success, and a one-attempt-per-command retry that resumes one missing comment.
